advices.diagnosis: The function exhibits high cyclomatic complexity (8) and deep nesting (7), indicating that the control flow is difficult to follow and maintain. The physical lines of code (15) are modest, but the nested loops and conditionals inflate the complexity metrics, suggesting that the logic could be simplified or decomposed.

suggestions.title: Refactor into helper functions and a generator

advices.risk_notes: Splitting the logic into multiple functions may alter the execution order or performance characteristics, especially if the original function relied on side‑effects or order of evaluation. Ensure that unit tests cover the new generator path and that the function still returns a list of tuples in the expected order.
